description: This file defines the SugarCachesMash class, which extends the abstract class SugarCacheAbstract. The class implements caching functionality using external storage in the /tmp directory, with methods for setting, getting, clearing, and resetting cache entries.

classes.name: SugarCachesMash
classes.description: A cache implementation that uses external tmp storage and extends SugarCacheAbstract.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the cache backend should be used based on parent class check, function existence, and configuration.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Stores a value in external cache storage using zput.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a value from external cache storage using zget.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry from external storage using zdelete.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Clears all cache entries in the external storage directory.
